title: tc-org-chart
description:
Who reports to whom: people's cards joined by reporting lines, branches that fold, search, a picked person's manager
and reports, pan and zoom, and an outline when narrow.

heading.description: The heading, and the chart's name

people.description: Everyone, in the order their manager lists them; `manager` joins them up

expanded.description: The people whose reports are shown; null shows the top of each tree and one level under it. Changed by the user unless tc-expanded-change is prevented

selected.description: The person picked. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

filter.description: What the search box holds. Changed by the user unless tc-filter-change is prevented

layout.description: "tree" draws cards top-down, "list" an indented outline; "auto" is the tree, the outline when narrow

name.description: The person's name; for a vacant role, what to call the gap ("Open role")

manager.description: The id of the person they report to

avatar.description: A picture URL; without one the card shows initials
